title: SubMine - SMP
description: Seasons of the year, guilds, a dynamic ecosystem, and more
body:
💥SubMine opens its doors to its players with new features...

● Want mechanisms? Create!
● Want to explore the world? A variety of biomes and dungeons will brighten up your leisure time.
● Want to farm? A variety of crops and mechanics will help you with that.
● Tired of boring mobs? No problem! There are new ones!
● Want to protect your building? Privates will help you!

And much more!
🗣The server will start on May 2 at 16:00 Moscow time.

👋How to get to our server?
IP: mc.submine.net
Version: 1.21.1
Kernel: Neoforge
❗It is also important to install the server modpack (without it, you will not be able to enter the server)!

🤩We are waiting for you dear friends! And may luck be on your side)
#SubMine #SubMineminecraft
